collection.description: A respected healer insists on continuing treatment for a dying friend, even after the friend asks for rest.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A respected healer insists on continuing treatment for a dying friend, even after the friend asks for rest.

choices.label: Honor the patient's request to stop.
Ask the healer to explain the remaining options.
Invite a neutral elder to help them talk.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The healer grieves but remains beside their friend.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The patient dies peacefully, and the healer later teaches apprentices about listening.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The healer admits that another procedure is unlikely to work.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The discussion helps the patient choose a final treatment on their own terms.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The healer struggles with guilt but accepts the patient's wishes.

c1__fx.name: Outcome C1
c1__fx.text: The friend and healer reconcile before the illness worsens.
